name: Mantine
summary: React component library with 120+ components and 70+ hooks, plus form, dates and charts packages and an MCP server.
description: Mantine is a React components and hooks library with native dark-theme support, built with plain CSS so styles have no runtime overhead. Packages cover core components, 80+ hooks, forms with schema validation, dates, recharts-based charts, notifications, Spotlight (⌘K command palette), Dropzone, Carousel, a Tiptap rich text editor and code highlighting. Docs ship as llms.txt/llms-full.txt, agent skills and an MCP server; templates exist for Next.js, Vite, React Router and TanStack Start.
contains: packages: core, hooks, form, charts, spotlight, notifications, dropzone, carousel, tiptap, code-highlight
148 components across all @mantine/* packages per site stats

llms.txt and llms-full.txt regenerated with every release; agent skills included
